description: Darwin Road Maintenance Area is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Logistics and Infrastructure. The datasets contain information relating to the Darwin Road Maintenance Area that fall under the care and control of the Northern Territory (NT) Government. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Logistics and Infrastructure. Its tags are Maintenance, Road. It offers 4 resource(s) in kmz, shp, xlsx. The portal shows 2024-05-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
